statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heartbeats
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I48.91, and R00.2
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
